component.name: Bay
component.summary: A fast browser with your tabs in a sidebar

description.p: Bay is a browser built around a sidebar. Favorites sit on top, pinned tabs and folders under them, and the day's tabs below. Spaces keep work and home apart, each with its own theme and its own sign-ins.
Built on Chromium, so sites and Chrome Web Store extensions work as they do in Chrome. Bay adds:

ul.li: Spaces, pinned tabs and folders, with unused tabs put away after a time you choose
Peek and Split View, to open links over or beside the page
A command bar for addresses, searches and open tabs
Built-in ad blocking with uBlock Origin Lite
Import from Arc, Chrome, Firefox, Brave and other browsers
